newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB gains Thai banking licence - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB gains Thai banking licence - paper.

text.p: Thailand has granted an offshore banking licence to National Australia Bank Ltd, The Australian newspaper reported on Thursday.
"The licence, among seven to be granted by the Bank of Thailand and the Thai Ministry of Finance puts the NAB one step away from a full banking licence," the newspaper said.
However, NAB spokesman Haydn Park said the bank was not yet aware of any decision on its application for the licence and it had not been contacted by Thai banking authorities.
"We haven't been advised, so we can't confirm or deny (the report)," he said.
Park said an official announcement regarding offshore banking licences was expected from Thailand next week.
NAB initially would enter the wholesale Thai banking market, should it be granted a licence, he said.
